decisions.reason: As a close fit with the firm's core pipeline and valve business, this product likely benefits from existing customer relationships, production capabilities, and the industry's favorable demand.
This public waste bin is relatively far from the firm's core infrastructure offer and is more likely to be discontinued so resources can be focused on stronger, technically closer product areas.

Although it can be sold to municipalities and uses coating know-how, this waste-bin-with-ashtray line remains outside the firm's main specialization and is only moderately likely to justify continued attention.
Outdoor ashtrays overlap with the firm's public-sector customer base but are still a non-core diversification with weaker strategic fit than the established metal pipeline business.
